title: Sign-up with valid data creates user
steps: POST /api/v1/users/signup with unique email, password of 8+ chars, full_name
expected: 200 with user public data (id, email, is_active=true, is_superuser=false); the response has no password or hashed_password.

title: Sign-up with duplicate email rejected
steps: POST /api/v1/users/signup again with the same email
expected: 400 with a detail saying the user already exists; no second record is created.

title: Sign-up with invalid email format
expected: 422 validation error pointing at the email field.

title: Sign-up password below minimum length (7 chars)
expected: 422 (password min_length 8 violated); no user is created.

title: Sign-up password at boundary lengths (8 and 128 chars) accepted, 129 rejected
expected: The first two return 200; the third returns 422.

title: Login with valid credentials returns token
expected: 200 with access_token and token_type='bearer'.

title: Login with wrong password
steps: POST /api/v1/login/access-token with a valid email and a wrong password
expected: 400 'Incorrect email or password'; no token is issued.

title: Login with non-existent user
expected: 400 with the same generic message as a wrong password, so there is no user enumeration.

title: Login with missing form fields
expected: 422 listing the missing username and password.

title: Tampered or invalid JWT rejected
steps: GET /api/v1/users/me with Authorization: Bearer <token with altered signature>
expected: 403 'Could not validate credentials'.

title: Create item with valid payload
expected: 200 with item id, matching title and description, and owner_id equal to user A's id.

title: Create item without title
expected: 422 with a missing title error.

title: Item title boundary: empty, 1, 255, 256 chars
expected: Lengths 1 and 255 return 200; lengths 0 and 256 return 422.

title: Item description boundary 255 / 256 chars
expected: 255 returns 200; 256 returns 422.

title: Items endpoints require authentication
steps: Call GET, POST, PUT and DELETE on /api/v1/items/ and /api/v1/items/{id} without a token
expected: Every call returns 401 status (message text not asserted).

title: List items returns only own items
steps: User A creates 2 items and user B creates 1
expected: 200 with data containing only A's 2 items and count=2.

title: Get item owned by another user
expected: 403 'Not enough permissions' and no item data in the body.

title: Update another user's item is blocked
steps: PUT /api/v1/items/{B's item id} with A's token and a new title
expected: PUT returns 403; the item is unchanged.

title: Delete another user's item is blocked
steps: DELETE /api/v1/items/{B's item id} with A's token
expected: DELETE returns 403; the item still exists.

title: Owner updates and deletes own item
expected: PUT returns 200 with the updated title; DELETE returns 200 with a success message; the final GET returns 404.

title: Get item with non-existent or malformed id
expected: The UUID request returns 404 'Item not found'; the malformed id returns 422.

title: Get own profile
expected: 200 with the current user's email and full_name.

title: Update own profile (full_name, email)
steps: PATCH /api/v1/users/me with a new full_name and email
expected: 200 with the updated values, which GET /users/me confirms.

title: Update own email to an existing user's email
steps: As user A, PATCH /api/v1/users/me with user B's email
expected: 409 'User with this email already exists'; A's email is unchanged.

title: Change password with correct current password
steps: PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password with current_password and a valid new_password
Log in with the new password
Log in with the old password
expected: PATCH returns 200; the new password logs in; the old password returns 400.

title: Change password with wrong current password or same password
steps: PATCH with new_password equal to current_password
expected: Both return 400 and the password is unchanged.

title: Normal user cannot access admin user endpoints
expected: Each call returns 403 'The user doesn't have enough privileges'.

title: Delete own account removes user
steps: Log in again with the same credentials
expected: DELETE returns 200; the later login fails with 400.

title: Superuser cannot delete own account
expected: 403 'Super users are not allowed to delete themselves'.

title: Sign up via UI form
steps: Enter full name, a unique email, a password, and the matching confirm password
expected: The account is created and the user is redirected to /login, with a success toast if one is shown.

title: Sign-up validation: mismatched passwords
steps: Enter different values in Password and Confirm Password
expected: An inline error says the passwords don't match; no API call is made.

title: Sign-up validation: short password and invalid email
expected: Inline errors appear for the email and for the minimum password length of 8; the form is not submitted.

title: Sign-up with an already registered email
steps: Submit the sign-up form with an existing email
expected: An error toast or message says the user already exists, and the user stays on /signup.

title: Login via UI with valid credentials
expected: The user is redirected to the dashboard, a token is stored, and the user's name or email shows in the layout.

title: Login via UI with wrong password
steps: Enter a valid email and a wrong password
expected: An error message such as 'Incorrect email or password' appears and the user stays on /login.

title: Login form empty and invalid email validation
steps: Submit with an invalid email format
expected: Inline validation errors appear and no request is sent.

title: Unauthenticated access to protected route redirects to login
expected: Both redirect to /login.

title: Create item through the UI
expected: The dialog closes and the new item appears in the table.

title: Item form requires title and enforces max length
expected: A required error shows for the empty title; a max-length error shows for 256 chars; no item is created.

title: Edit item through the UI
steps: On /items open the row actions menu
expected: The table row shows the updated title.

title: Delete item through the UI with confirmation
expected: The item is removed from the list and a success toast appears. Cancelling the dialog keeps the item.

title: Items list shows only the logged-in user's items
steps: Log out and log in as user B
expected: B does not see A's items; an empty state shows if B has none.

title: Update profile in settings
expected: A success toast appears and the new name shows after reload.

title: Change password in settings
steps: Enter current password, new password and confirm
Log out and log in with the new password
expected: A success toast appears and login works with the new password.

title: Change password validation: mismatch and wrong current
steps: Enter a mismatched confirm password and submit
Enter a wrong current password with matching new passwords and submit
expected: The mismatch is flagged inline with no request sent; the wrong current password shows an error toast from the API 400.

title: Non-superuser cannot access admin page
steps: Log in as a normal user
expected: The Admin link is hidden and /admin shows no user management data (redirect or forbidden).

title: Users endpoints reject requests with no token
expected: Each call returns 401 status; no user data returned.

title: Item write operations reject requests with no token
expected: Each call returns 401 status; the item still exists unchanged for user A.
